from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right


def is_majority(arr, n, x):
    """Write a function to check for majority element in the given sorted array.

    Return True if ``x`` occurs more than ``n / 2`` times in the first
    ``n`` elements of the sorted array ``arr``, otherwise return False.
    Uses binary search, so it runs in O(log n) time on a sorted array.
    """
    if not arr or n is None or n <= 0:
        return False

    # ``n`` is the logical size of the array; never read past ``arr``.
    size = min(n, len(arr))
    if size <= 0:
        return False

    first = bisect_left(arr, x, 0, size)
    if first >= size or arr[first] != x:
        return False

    count = bisect_right(arr, x, first, size) - first
    return count > size / 2
